name: Climate box
description: A small single-span house of 32 tomato plants, shut and still, where climate equipment is tried, 14 days

notes.scenario: The small house of P05.0: small enough to follow its air closely, where P05's equipment is placed and its QA run. It has a roof vent, a side vent in each side wall and a door, all shut, so that equipment acts on still, closed air.
notes.installation.envelope: One 6.4 m span, three 4 m bays, 4 m to the gutters. The left side vent is across the house from the right one, so that a wind across the house has a vent on either side (P07.6).
notes.installation.layout: Two rows of 16 plants along the house, 1.6 m apart about its middle, on gutters under crop wires, behind a path across the front; and its equipment, all off until commanded: a fan high over the front path blowing down the house, a 10 kW heater in the back right corner, and a dehumidifier against the left side wall, halfway along; and its sensors: temperature and humidity in each half of the house, an anemometer in the fan's jet, CO2 in the middle and PAR under the roof; and a weather station on a mast 3 m in front of the house: its air's temperature and humidity side by side 1.5 m up, the pressure below them, and the wind's speed and direction 6 m up, above the ridge.
notes.models.air_field: Still air, so that a fan's jet stands out.
notes.models.house_air: A cold, damp night, when heating and drying matter: 16 °C and 85% inside to start, through single glass.
notes.models.weather: The cold, damp night outside: 8 °C and 90%, still.
